model.description: Defaul model to use for the agent *

contextWindow.description:
Context window (tokens) used as the reference for masking and
handoff pressure. When unset, the model's full declared context
is used. Set it to keep the session inside a "good" window — models
degrade well before their max, so firing a handoff relative to a
smaller window avoids the hallucination zone.

mode.description:
scrollback: preserves terminal scrollback/search; footer scrolls away with mouse wheel because the terminal is scrolling
/* fullscreen: alternate screen + mouse; footer stays fixed; dedicated app viewport

collapsedTools.description: Tools whose result body should be hidden in the UI.

images.description: Render images, if supported by the terminal

listHeight.description: Maximum number of visible rows in selection lists, like pickers and autocomplete.

reasoning.description: Whether to show the reasoning trace in the UI.

theme.description: Theme name or path to custom theme file

sessionTree.description: What messages to show in the session tree. Defaults to assistant, reasoning, and tools.

treeHeight.description: Maximum number of visible rows in the session tree.

enabled.description: Allow skills to be used by the agent. Defaults to true.

actions.description: Show skill actions. Defaults to true.

actionPrefix.description: Prefix for command actions. Defaults to `skill:`, e.g `/skill:SKILL_NAME`
Prefix for command actions. Defaults to ``

bash.description: Allow bash execution in commands. Defaults to true.

expr.description: Allow js expressions in command templates. Defaults to true.

enabled.description:
Enable the automatic handoff when context is full or the session
is degraded. The degradation trigger fires on redundancy — the
sliding mean of per-turn novelty dropping below
`redundancy.threshold` — ahead of the pressure threshold,
because the dilution curve is visible in the model's behavior
well before the window fills.

keepTokens.description: Existing messages up to this many tokens will be preserved in the context

model.description:
Model id used to generate the handoff summary. Falls back to
the session model when unset. Summarization is mechanical
extraction — a cheaper model does it nearly as well.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for the handoff summary

summaryTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to use for the generated summary

redundancy.description:
Redundancy-based degradation detection (the handoff trigger).
Overrides the defaults — the trigger is enabled with a 0.4
novelty threshold over a 5-turn sliding window.

enabled.description: Whether to enable masking. Defaults to true.

minTokens.description:
Don't mask tool-result parts whose original content is shorter
than this (estimated tokens). Skips tiny "ok"-style success
messages where the stub would be larger than the original.
Doesn't apply to attachments (always worth masking).

keepTurns.description:
How many turns to keep in the tail of the conversation, regardless
of score. Defaults to 20.

delta.description:
How far above the target ratio to trigger a new masking pass.
Defaults to 0.25 (25%).

target.description: Target ratio of used/limit tokens to reach by masking. Defaults to 0.5 (50%).

preset.description: Permissions preset to use. Defaults to "permissive".

mcp.description: MCP servers exposed as tools by the MCP adapter.

bash.description: Command used by the bash tool.

npm.description: Package manager command used for npm packs.

system.description: System integrations and external commands used by zaly.

command.description: Command that starts the server, e.g. `npx`.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process.

tools.description:
Only register these tools, by the server's own names. Unset means
every tool the server advertises.

disabled.description: Skip this server without removing its entry.

enabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled. Defaults to true.

include.description: When set, only include the resources, matching these paths/globs from the plugin.

exclude.description:
When set, exclude the resources, matching these paths/globs from the plugin.
Add a resource type to the exclude list to disable that resource type. For example,
`["skills"]` will disable all skills from the plugin.
Exclude is applied after include.
